MINE 200.title: Mineral Resources Engineering I
MINE 200.description: Introduction to the mining life cycle and the design, planning, operation, and closure of mining systems, with a focus on mining methods, mineral processing, community engagement, and social license to operate.

MINE 201.title: Mineral Resources Engineering II
MINE 201.description: The design, planning, and operation, and closure of mining operations, with a focus on mineral processing technologies, plant design, waste and tailings management, and the future of mining. .

MINE 202.title: Mineralogy for Resources Engineering
MINE 202.description: Fundamentals of rock and minerals formation. Exploring main techniques used to understand implications of mineralogy in mining and mineral processing. .

MINE 224.title: Mineralogy for Mining Engineering
MINE 224.description: Fundamentals of the rock and minerals formation. Exploring main techniques used to understand implications of mineralogy in mining and mineral processing. .

MINE 291.title: Introduction to Mining
MINE 291.description: Leading practices and technologies employed in the design, planning, and operation of mining systems. Life cycle of surface and underground mining systems. .

MINE 292.title: Introduction to Mineral Processing
MINE 292.description: Overview; extracting a mineral or final product from an ore. .

MINE 293.title: Seminar
MINE 293.description: Oral presentations of topics on mine safety, and mining engineering by industry practitioners, faculty and/or stake- and rights-holders.

MINE 302.title: Underground Mining and Design
MINE 302.description: Selection, design, and development of underground mining methods based upon physical, geological, economic, and environmental constraints. Underground excavation methods and equipment selection. .

MINE 303.title: Rock Engineering Fundamentals
MINE 303.description: The study of the mechanical and structural properties of rock materials at the laboratory and field scale, with reference to common mining, geological and civil engineering problems. .

MINE 304.title: Rock Fragmentation
MINE 304.description: Theory and practice of rock fragmentation by drilling and blasting; introduction to explosives and initiation systems; design of surface and underground blasts; machine excavation systems for tunneling and stoping; environmental impacts, safety, and risk assessment. .

MINE 310.title: Surface Mining and Design
MINE 310.description: Surface mining methods, calculation of pit limits, cutoff grades, break-even criteria, stripping ratios, ultimate pit depth and dimensions, and pit sequencing. Geotechnical inputs to surface mine design. Loading and hauling equipment, production rates, capacity and systems. .

MINE 331.title: Physical Mineral Processes
MINE 331.description: Mineral processing unit operations and sampling, crushing, grinding, screening, classification, gravity separation, magnetic separation, electrostatic separation, concentrate dewatering practices.

MINE 333.title: Flotation
MINE 333.description: Theory and technology of flotation and ancillary processes. .

MINE 350.title: Modelling and Simulation
MINE 350.description: Methods for determining the behaviour of large scale industrial systems and their application to the design and analysis of such systems. .

MINE 380.title: Mine Waste Management
MINE 380.description: Basic geotechnical, hydrological, and water management aspects of mine waste management. .

MINE 393.title: Seminar
MINE 393.description: Oral presentation of topics by instructor and guest lecturers. .

MINE 395.title: Mineral Deposit Modelling
MINE 395.description: Types of mineral deposits. Exploration and sampling methods. Methods for data analysis and computer modelling of mineral deposits and their use in production planning and design. .

MINE 396.title: Engineering Economics
MINE 396.description: Discrete and continuous cash flow models, discounted cash flow analysis, effects of depreciation and taxes, economic analysis of projects, sensitivity and risk analysis, financing and cost of capital. .

MINE 402.title: Mine Ventilation and Occupational Health and Safety
MINE 402.description: Design and analysis for ventilation systems for mining. Topics such as ventilation design, ventilation surveys, thermodynamic aspects, psychrometry of air and air conditioning. .

MINE 403.title: Rock Engineering Design
MINE 403.description: The design of rock slopes and underground openings with respect to stress, structure and the rock mass. Stabilization and monitoring of rock movement. .

MINE 404.title: Strategic Issues in Mining
MINE 404.description: Strategic issues in an organization; types of organizations; personnel evaluations and job rating systems; impact of manpower planning on decision-making; union negotiations; public relations; dealing with the media; corporate responsibilities to society and employees. .

MINE 405.title: Introduction to Risk Management for Mining and Large Industrial Projects
MINE 405.description: Risk management and its application to mining and large industrial projects, including risk analysis, treatment, and governance. .

MINE 406.title: Mine Project Valuation and Risk Assessment
MINE 406.description: Mineral economics and finance. Analytical tools and techniques used in the valuation of mining companies and the financial analysis and risk assessment methods.

MINE 420.title: Applied Geostatistics
MINE 420.description: Geostatistical analysis and simulation of spatiotemporal phenomena in natural and engineered systems with applications to mining problems. .

MINE 432.title: Mineral Process Control
MINE 432.description: Automatic control theory, PID control, Laplace and z-transforms, loop tuning, frequency response, stability analysis, control strategies in flotation, comminution, dewatering, reagent and bin/sump levels, automated load-haul-dump and drilling equipment, instrumentation and soft sensors. .

MINE 434.title: Processing Precious Metal Ores
MINE 434.description: Process alternatives and mineralogical considerations; physical and chemical recovery technologies; environmental protection; flowsheet studies. .

MINE 435.title: Plant and Process Design
MINE 435.description: Design of unit operations in a mineral processing plant including crushing, grinding, classification, gravity separation, magnetic separation, flotation, thickening and filtration. Equipment selection and sizing, flowsheet design, circuit analysis and processing options. .

MINE 436.title: Industrial Mixing
MINE 436.description: Fundamentals of mixing technology, and industrial mixing systems and equipment. Selection, design, monitor, and scale-up mixing systems for mining applications. .
MINE 436.prerequisiteText: MATH_V 255 and one of MECH_V 280, CIVL_V 215

MINE 438.title: Advanced Process Mineralogy
MINE 438.description: Textural parameters, such as mineral liberation size and mineral associations in connection with the mineral processing techniques for mineral recovery. .

MINE 444.title: Urban Mining: Recovering Value From E-waste
MINE 444.description: Technological and social issues related to the recovery of value from e-waste seen through the eyes of engineers, social scientists and economists. Recovery of valuable minerals in the context of circular economy to provide sustainable solutions for our planet. .

MINE 447.title: Dewatering of Fine Tailings
MINE 447.description: Interparticle forces; DLVO theory of colloid stability; dispersion, coagulation, and flocculation phenomena; settling; thickening and consolidation processes; polymers in mineral processing; measurement techniques in tailings treatment; thickeners and principles of operation; industrial practice. .

MINE 455.title: Mine Water Management
MINE 455.description: Mine water management covering integrated water resource management, water balances, sources, water use optimization, water quality and treatment and long-term stewardship. .

MINE 462.title: Coal Preparation Technology
MINE 462.description: Thermal and metallurgical coals: objectives of their cleaning; coal washability and flotability fundamentals; coal preparation unit operations; performance characteristics of coal washing equipment; products dewatering; plant flowsheets. .

MINE 465.title: Materials Handling
MINE 465.description: Knowledge and understanding of equipment used in mining operations, including diesel, electro-mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic equipment as well as conveyors, load-haul-dump trucks and pumps. .

MINE 470.title: Indigenous Peoples and Mining in Canada
MINE 470.description: Historical context of Indigenous peoples of Canada interactions with the development of mineral resources. Current best practices and systems supporting effective engagement and involvement of Indigenous peoples in the development of mines and mineral resources. .

MINE 482.title: Maintenance Engineering
MINE 482.description: Analytical foundation for maintenance of industrial plant equipment and mobile equipment in various production environments; maintenance planning and management, life cycle analysis, reliability theory, total quality maintenance, condition monitoring. .

MINE 485.title: Cave Mining Systems: Design and Planning
MINE 485.description: Designs, planning, and leading practices are applied to underground mining systems reliant on induced and controlled rock mass caving. .

MINE 486.title: Mining and The Environment
MINE 486.description: Environmental topics of importance to engineers practicing within the mining, metallurgical and related industries including technical practices, regulatory and public issues. .

MINE 488.title: Heavy Oil Sand Mining and Processing
MINE 488.description: Life cycle of the production of Oil Sands resources, including mining, bitumen extraction, and reclamation. .

MINE 491.title: Mine and Plant Engineering Design Feasibility Study
MINE 491.description: Mining Engineering design project from scope definition to final design and project feasibility. Based on a problem from industry and/or research. .
MINE 491.prerequisiteText: All of MINE_V 302, MINE_V 303, MINE_V 310, MINE_V 331, MINE_V 333, MINE_V 350, MINE_V 396

MINE 493.title: Seminar
MINE 493.description: Oral presentation of a technical nature. Use of closed circuit television for personal evaluation. .

MINE 497.title: Directed Studies
MINE 497.description: Requires approval of the department head.

MINE 501.title: Topics for Engineers in the Mining Industry
MINE 501.description: Leading practices and technologies employed in the Canadian Mining Industry. Topics include: mining, mineral processing, mine finance and mining and the environment.

MINE 504.title: Rock Fragmentation
MINE 504.description: Theory and practice of drilling and blasting; explosive types and strengths. Blast pattern design for underground and surface operations. Permission of the instructor is required.

MINE 505.title: Advanced Topics in Rock Engineering
MINE 505.description: Rock mass properties and numerical modelling applied to rock engineering design with particular emphasis on applications in rock slopes and tunneling. Permission of the instructor is required.

MINE 506.title: Mining Methods
MINE 506.description: A more advanced study of some aspects of mining methods. Permission of the instructor is required.

MINE 507.title: Block Caving Systems
MINE 507.description: Mass mining (caving) methods, their design and operation, the value proposition and the key value drivers.

MINE 508.title: Integrated Mining and Processing Systems
MINE 508.description: Methods and systems for integrated mining and processing, conceptual model development, simulation, economic and technical evaluation. Permission of the instructor is required.

MINE 509.title: Mine Ventilation
MINE 509.description: Mine air conditioning, ventilation network analysis, radioactivity in mining, case studies in mine ventilation and control of dust, fumes and diesel exhausts.

MINE 520.title: Advanced Coal Preparation
MINE 520.description: Thermal and metallurgical coals. Desulphurization Theory of coal beneficiation. Dense media separation. Coal surface properties and their effect on fine coal processing by flotation and oil agglomeration; coal/water/slurries. Plant performance testing and instrumentation. Permission of the instructor is required.

MINE 522.title: Processing of Mineral Fines
MINE 522.description: Particulate systems. Role of particle size and interfacial phenomena in properties of disperse systems. Stability of colloids and suspensions DLVO (Dejaguin-Landau-Vervey-Overbeek).

MINE 524.title: Processing of Precious Metal Ores
MINE 524.description: Advances in science and technology for recovering gold, silver, and platinum group elements.

MINE 526.title: Mathematical Modelling of Mineral Processes
MINE 526.description: Emphasis on crushing, grinding, screening, classification and flotation.

MINE 527.title: Simulation and Optimization of Mineral Processes
MINE 527.description: Mineral process simulators including off-line optimization strategies; optimal flow sheet design.

MINE 529.title: Rheology of Mineral Suspensions
MINE 529.description: Rheological measurements, flow curve modelling, micro-rheology, control of rheological properties. Application to mineral processing unit operations.

MINE 533.title: Treatment of Mineral Industry Effluents
MINE 533.description: Characteristics of mineral dispersions in gases and in water; dust suppression in mining and in mineral transport facilities; solid-liquid separations; removal of noxious chemicals; waste disposal systems.

MINE 540.title: Acid Rock Drainage
MINE 540.description: Lectures and seminars on topics of importance in acid rock drainage including fundamentals of ARD generation, prediction, prevention, control, treatment and monitoring for waste management and regulatory control in the mining industry.

MINE 541.title: Environmental Risk Assessments in Relation to Mining
MINE 541.description: Advanced topics related to mining environment selected in consultation with the instructor.

MINE 544.title: Mining Environment Case Studies
MINE 544.description: Regulatory requirements for mine-mill environmental protection in design, operation and closure. Studies of environmental impact statements and closure plans.

MINE 547.title: Industrial Expert Systems
MINE 547.description: The use of artificial intelligence to solve complex problems in industry. Topics include knowledge acquisition, knowledge representation, knowledge accumulation, and conflict resolution.

MINE 551.title: Applied Underground Rock Mechanics
MINE 551.description: Study of design methods; underground engineering of openings, pillars and support. Emphasis on design with input being stress, structure and rock mass, employing analytical, empirical and numerical tools.

MINE 552.title: Mining Geostatistics
MINE 552.description: Basic geostatistical concepts. Applications of geostatistical techniques and stochastic simulation to orebody modelling and grade control.

MINE 553.title: Modelling of Industrial Systems
MINE 553.description: Use of mathematical programming, network theory, queuing models and simulation to model service and production operations in industry. Use of models in decision-making.

MINE 554.title: Mine Economics and Finance
MINE 554.description: Mine valuation using discounted cash flow analysis and option pricing methods. Sources of mine finance and requirements. Sensitivity and risk assessment. Introduction to metals marketing, hedging and risk management.

MINE 555.title: Mining and Society
MINE 555.description: Discussion of social, political and technical topics concerning mining-related activities.

MINE 559.title: Indigenous Peoples and Mining in Canada
MINE 559.description: Permission of the instructor is required.

MINE 581.title: Safety of Tailings Storage Facilities
MINE 581.description: Safety evaluation of tailings storage facilities as a system, including tailings transport and containment structures. Consequence classifications. Credible failure modes. Breach analyses. Risk management and reporting. Emergency planning. Critical controls. Change management. Governance frameworks.

MINE 582.title: Maintenance Engineering
MINE 582.description: The analytical foundation for maintenance of industrial plant equipment and mobile equipment in various production environments. Reliability theory, sensing technology and theory, risk analysis, and operations research applied to maintenance management.

MINE 584.title: Energy from the Earth: Renewable Versus Conventional
MINE 584.description: Coal, oil, gas, uranium, hydro, wind, geothermal, and geosolar.

MINE 585.title: Risk Management of Tailings Storage Facilities

MINE 586.title: Advanced Mine Waste Management
MINE 586.description: Advanced geotechnical, hydrological, and water management aspects of mine waste management.

MINE 587.title: Advanced Mine Site Management
MINE 587.description: Advanced mine site management topics including site and corporate governance and responsibility for mine waste facilities, specifically tailings; the role and responsibilities of the Engineer of Record; geochemistry of mine waste and mine closure realities.

MINE 588.title: Risk Assessment for Mine Waste Management
MINE 588.description: Risk assessment and management topics including risk assessment methodologies, risk management, and decision-making under risk.

MINE 589.title: Mine Waste Management Case Studies
MINE 589.description: Case study analysis including design, construction, operations and closure of mine waste facilities.

MINE 590.title: Special Advanced Topics
MINE 590.description: A special advanced course may be arranged upon the approval of the department head.

MINE 591.title: Communication Skills and Workplace Readiness
MINE 591.description: Preparation for mining and mineral processing engineering internships. The course includes workshops on the following topics: developing a synopsis of qualifications, written communication and interviewing skills for the engineering professional. Pass/fail.

MINE 592.title: Mining Industry Internship
MINE 592.description: Mining or mineral processing engineering internship in which concepts, theory and practice of mining and mineral processing engineering are applied by working with industry on appropriate technical projects. Pass/fail.

MINE 597.title: Engineering Project
MINE 597.description: A project involving laboratory, pilot plant or field work is to be completed in close collaboration with an academic advisor. For M.Eng. students only.

MINE 598.title: Seminar
MINE 598.description: Topics in mining, mineral processing and the environment for M.A.Sc. and M.Eng. students.

MINE 698.title: Seminar
MINE 698.description: Topics in mining and mineral processing for Ph.D. students.
